notes: Text backbone is Qwen2 (DotsOCRForCausalLM extends Qwen2ForCausalLM).
Vision tower is the custom DotsVisionTransformer loaded via trust_remote_code.
No Qwen2-specific or DotsVision-specific attention integration exists yet; attention tests swap only inner Linears + activations via register_modules and keep the attention math in torch.

TTNNLocalRMSNorm.notes: Supports rms_norm modules that expose .eps instead of .variance_epsilon (DotsVision RMSNorm).

TTNNSilu.notes: Vision SwiGLU FFN calls F.silu functionally; substituting requires a wrapper Module.

TTNNConv2dNHWC.notes: Not exercised by the generated tier-1 tests for dots_ocr; listed for completeness.

_unmapped.Qwen2Attention: No Qwen2-specific integration -- tested via inner-Linear swaps only.
_unmapped.DotsVisionAttention: No vision-attention integration -- tested via inner-Linear swaps only.
_unmapped.DotsVisionTransformer: Tier-4 full vision model not currently swappable; tier-4 test is skip-marked.
_unmapped.DotsOCRForCausalLM: Multimodal entry point; tier-4 full-model test is skip-marked (requires real checkpoint + image inputs).
